standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Derived Categories, lemmas commutes-with-countable-sums and factor-through (cross-chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: The class of alpha lands in some K_n and factors through an object of the thick closure of the generator.

core_obligations: Set D = D_QCoh,T(O_X); in both cases K = R SheafHom(P, E) lies in D and is supported on T; alpha defines an element of H^0(K), reducing the problem to the map O_X[0] -> K.
Write K = hocolim K_n using the perfect generator; the subcategory-to-ambient functor commutes with direct sums, so the colimit description holds in D(O_X).
Since O_X is compact, alpha factors as O_X[0] -> K_n for some n, and then as O_X[0] -> Q -> K_n with Q in the thick closure of the generator; Q is perfect and supported on T.
The distinguished triangle I -> O_X[0] -> Q -> I[1] gives: I perfect; I -> O_X[0] restricts to an isomorphism over U; and the composition I -> K is zero since alpha factors through Q.
Conclude I tensor^L P -> E is zero (the I-action kills K) while I is trivial off T.
proof_roadmap: Internal-Hom reduction; hocolim over the generator; compactness and factorization; triangle construction; conclusion.
